blk_part_01_part_1_a_greeting_that_carri.text: In Japan, bowing is the common greeting. But not every bow is the same. The bow changes with social status, so it depends on who is greeting whom. A bow to a senior manager is not the same as a bow to a friend. The words change too. People say "konnichiwa" in the daytime and "konbanwa" in the evening. They use these words when they meet someone for the first time that day.
